title: The third fuse box
body: The closet behind the break room is on no plan. The lock is a latch. Inside: mops that have never dried, a fuse box labelled with a floor that does not exist, and a second labelled with the floor you are standing on. Your torch shows a third fuse box, behind the first two, painted over. It is warm.

outcome.text: Inside: a single fuse, stamped 1207. It is not connected to anything. It is not a fuse. You put it back. It was warm.
The latch clicks. The closet is a closet again. You hear, behind the door, one soft knock. Just the one.
